name: Captain Feed for YouTube
author: Devang Vachheta

sections.description:
Captain Feed for YouTube is a fast, beginner-friendly YouTube feed plugin for WordPress. Show your latest YouTube videos, playlists, Shorts, search results and hand-picked videos in a responsive YouTube gallery, grid, slider or playlist player, with no coding. Build a feed in a guided 5-step wizard, copy the shortcode (or use the Elementor widget or Gutenberg block) and your YouTube content is live on your site.

Built for YouTubers, bloggers, businesses, agencies, course creators, churches, podcasters and WordPress developers who want to embed YouTube videos on a WordPress website, grow their channel, and keep visitors watching on their own site.

YouTube Tutorials | Facebook Community | Free Support

Why choose Captain Feed for YouTube?

  • Every YouTube feed type in one plugin : channel feed, playlist feed, Shorts feed, search feed, single videos, channel profile card and no-API-key embed.
  • Fast and quota-friendly : API response caching, an optional fallback cache that keeps your videos on screen even if YouTube or your API quota fails, and built-in API quota tracking.
  • Privacy-first : Privacy-Enhanced Mode (youtube-nocookie.com) is on by default, no tracking cookies, and a suggested privacy policy text for WordPress.
  • Works with your builder : shortcode, Elementor widget, Gutenberg block and a ready-to-paste PHP snippet for theme templates.
  • Looks great everywhere : responsive on desktop, tablet and mobile, with dark mode and RTL support.
  • Upgrade only if you need more : the free plugin is complete for most sites, and Captain Feed for YouTube Pro adds Live Streams, Call to Action overlays, Analytics, Downtime Alerts, Consent-Before-Load, Speed Optimizer, Infinity Load, WebP thumbnails and White Label.

📺 YouTube Feed Types

  • YouTube Channel Feed : show the latest videos from any channel using a Channel ID or @handle.
  • YouTube Playlist Feed : show every video from a public playlist, including a YouTube-style playlist player layout.
  • YouTube Shorts Feed : display vertical Shorts in a responsive 9:16 layout, as a grid, slider or scroll row.
  • YouTube Live Stream Feed (Pro) : show active live broadcasts and scheduled premieres with an animated pulsing LIVE badge and a clean offline notice when nothing is live.
  • YouTube Search Feed : build a dynamic video gallery from any search query, keyword, topic or brand.
  • Individual Videos Feed : hand-pick the exact videos you want to feature, using video URLs or IDs.
  • Embed Video : paste one YouTube URL and embed it instantly. No YouTube API key needed.
  • Channel Profile : show the channel banner, avatar, name, subscriber count, video count, view count and a Subscribe button, in light or dark mode.

🎨 Layouts, Sliders and Card Designs (Free)

  • Card designs : Classic Card, Social Card (views, likes and comments row), Dark Cinematic, Professional, Playlist, Shorts Card, and Short Style 1. Short Style 2 (Pro) adds a social-card Shorts design with avatar, handle and likes and comments row.
  • Grid or Slider : responsive grid with custom columns and gaps, or choose from 3 slider styles (Equal Cards, Spotlight, and Carousel with a counter and progress bar). Auto slide and infinite loop options included.
  • Equal card height : keep every card in a row aligned, even with different title lengths.
  • Show or hide details : channel name, title and description can each be switched off independently on every card style.
  • Pagination and Load More : show a few videos first and load more with a button. Pro adds Infinity Load (auto-load on scroll) and separate Initial Videos and Videos Per Click for tablet and mobile.
  • Columns and Max Videos : choose preset columns and video counts. Pro unlocks custom columns (up to 12 per device) and 1 to 50 videos.
  • Video Order and Max Videos controls to decide what appears and how many.

▶️ Video Play Modes (Free)

  • Popup lightbox : play videos in a clean, accessible popup (GLightbox). Pro adds Call to Action overlays on pause or end.
  • Play inline : play the video right inside the card, one at a time.
  • Open on YouTube : send visitors to YouTube to watch and subscribe.

🖌️ Full Styling with Live Preview (Free)

Style every part of your YouTube gallery visually: card background, borders, radius, shadows, padding, margin, colors, and typography for title, description and stats. A built-in color picker supports HEX and RGBA with alpha. See changes instantly in a Live Preview with a Desktop / Tablet / Mobile switcher. Pro adds Responsive Typography (font size, line height and letter spacing per device), Thumbnail Quality (Full HD, Standard, Medium), WebP thumbnails and a custom Channel Profile avatar shape.

🧹 Video Filters (Free)

Keep your feed clean and on-brand. Include or exclude videos by keyword, hide videos shorter than a minimum duration, or hide videos below a minimum view count. Chip-based suggestions are built from your own channel’s video titles.

🔌 Elementor, Gutenberg and Shortcode (Free)

  • Elementor widget : drag the “Captain YouTube Feed” widget onto any page, pick a feed, and see it styled live in the editor.
  • Gutenberg block : add the “Captain YouTube Feed” block in the WordPress block editor.
  • Shortcode : [captain-feed-for-youtube id="1"] works in any page, post, widget area or page builder.
  • PHP snippet : a ready-to-use function (with a “cannot redeclare” safety check) for theme templates.

⚡ Performance and Reliability (Free)

  • API response caching with WordPress transients to cut requests and speed up page loads.
  • Fallback Cache : keeps the last good videos on screen if the YouTube API fails or your daily quota runs out.
  • API quota tracking with automatic back-off and reset when you update your key or clear the cache.
  • Feed Health and Diagnostics : connection check, cache status and last sync for each feed.
  • Per-feed cache clearing and global cache controls.
  • No external Google Fonts : feeds do not load fonts from Google, which is better for speed and privacy.
  • Pro Speed Optimizer : native thumbnail lazy loading, preconnect hints, conditional asset loading, local thumbnail caching and a live Speed and Cache Report.
  • Pro Downtime Alerts : email, Slack or Discord alerts when a feed fails, with automatic recovery notices.
  • Pro Feed Analytics : impressions, plays, watch time, CTA conversions and top videos, with no personal data stored.
  • Pair it with the free Captain Media Shield to convert thumbnails and site media to WebP/AVIF for even higher PageSpeed scores.

🔒 Privacy and GDPR Tools (Free)

  • Privacy-Enhanced Mode : all players, lightboxes and Shorts load from www.youtube-nocookie.com by default, so YouTube sets no cookies until playback.
  • No tracking cookies and no visitor personal data stored by the plugin.
  • Suggested Privacy Policy text registered under Settings > Privacy > Policy Guide.
  • Upgrade to Pro for click-to-load Consent-Before-Load with automatic Complianz, Cookiebot, CookieYes and Borlabs Cookie detection.

🧰 Admin Experience (Free)

  • Modern React admin dashboard with a guided 5-step feed wizard (Connect Channel, Layout, Mode, Settings, Insert Code).
  • Light and dark admin mode, collapsible sidebar, drag and drop settings cards, mobile-friendly admin.
  • YouTube API key Test Key button with clear error messages (quota exceeded, invalid key, IP restriction, channel not found).
  • Built-in Documentation with guides for the API key, Channel ID, @handle, Playlist ID, Shorts, feed types, customizing a feed, caching, quota tracking, AI assistants and White Label.
  • Quick Support panel with a plugin overview video, free support, feature requests and community links.
  • Version Rollback : go back to any of the last 10 plugin versions from the WordPress admin.
  • Full RTL support and a translation-ready text domain.
  • Clean uninstall option to remove feeds, settings and cached data.

🤖 AI Assistant / MCP Integration (Free)

On WordPress 6.9 or newer, Captain Feed for YouTube registers its feed tools with the core Abilities API, so AI assistants such as Claude, Cursor or ChatGPT can create, list, update, duplicate, delete and diagnose your feeds through any MCP bridge plugin (such as Easy MCP AI or the official WordPress MCP Adapter). It is optional, every ability can be switched on or off from the MCP page, and it is limited to users with the manage_options capability.

🚀 Captain Feed for YouTube Pro

Everything above is free. When you want more conversions, more speed and more control, add Captain Feed for YouTube Pro. The free plugin shows these features locked, so you can see exactly what you get:

  • 🔴 YouTube Live Streams and Premieres : show live broadcasts and scheduled premieres with an animated pulsing LIVE badge and a clean offline state.
  • 🎯 Call to Action (CTA) Overlays : when a video is paused or ends, show a Subscribe prompt, a “watch next” video switcher or a custom button, as a banner or card, with pause delay and full styling.
  • 📊 Feed Analytics : privacy-friendly impressions, card clicks, video plays, watch time, CTA conversions, click-through rate and a top videos table, with interactive charts. No IP addresses, user IDs or cookies stored.
  • 🚨 Downtime Alerts and Incident Monitoring : get email, Slack or Discord alerts when a feed fails (quota exhausted, invalid key, deleted channel), with failure thresholds, no-spam deduplication and automatic recovery notices.
  • ⚡ Speed Optimizer and Core Web Vitals : native thumbnail lazy loading, preconnect hints to Google CDNs, conditional asset loading, local thumbnail caching and a live Speed and Cache Report.
  • 🛡️ Consent-Before-Load (GDPR / CCPA / ePrivacy) : 2-click video placeholder with custom text, button, colors and privacy link, plus automatic CMP detection for Complianz, Cookiebot, CookieYes and Borlabs Cookie.
  • ♾️ Infinity Load : the next videos load automatically as visitors scroll.
  • 📱 Device-specific load counts : separate Initial Videos and Videos Per Click for tablet and mobile.
  • 🔢 Custom Columns and Max Videos : up to 12 columns per device and 1 to 50 videos.
  • 🔤 Responsive Typography : font size, line height and letter spacing for desktop, tablet and mobile.
  • 🩳 Short Style 2 : social-card Shorts design with avatar, handle and likes and comments row.
  • 🖼️ Thumbnail Quality and WebP : pin Full HD, Standard or Medium thumbnails and serve smaller WebP images with automatic JPG fallback.
  • ⭕ Custom Channel Profile avatar shape : any corner radius.
  • 🏷️ White Label for agencies : rename the plugin, set custom menu icons, hide menu items, rebrand the Elementor widget and Gutenberg block, and hide the plugin from the Plugins list.

Get Captain Feed for YouTube Pro

Perfect for

  • YouTube creators who want to showcase new uploads and grow subscribers
  • Businesses displaying product demos, testimonials and explainer videos
  • Bloggers embedding related YouTube videos in posts
  • Agencies building video sections for clients (with White Label in Pro)
  • Course creators, coaches and educators with video lessons and playlists
  • Churches, podcasters and event sites displaying sermons, episodes and live streams
  • Websites that want a YouTube Shorts gallery or a video portfolio

🌟 OUR PRODUCTS

🥇 Captain Media Shield : Automatically optimize photos and videos, convert images to WebP/AVIF across your full WordPress website, and speed up page load times.

🥇 Captain Advance Filter : Create powerful filters for WordPress with advanced filtering options, flexible layouts, and easy customization.

🥇 Captain Social Review : Display reviews and testimonials from multiple platforms with beautiful layouts, filtering options, and easy customization.

🥇 Captain Widgets Kit : Extend your WordPress website with a collection of powerful widgets and elements designed to enhance your website building experience.

🥇 Captain Funnel : Automate WhatsApp messages for WooCommerce orders and form submissions using the official WhatsApp Cloud API by Meta.

🥇 Captain Live Chat : Self-hosted live chat for WordPress with an AI agent, canned replies and full conversation history – no monthly subscription.

External Services

Captain Feed for YouTube connects to Google and YouTube services to retrieve and display videos:

  1. YouTube Data API v3 (www.googleapis.com): the server sends your API key plus the Channel ID or @handle, Playlist ID, video IDs or search query you configured, to fetch videos and channel data. Sent when a feed is first fetched, refreshed after cache expiry, or previewed in admin.
  2. YouTube oEmbed (www.youtube.com/oembed): for the Embed Video type, the server sends the video URL you entered to get the title and channel name. No API key is used.
  3. YouTube players (www.youtube-nocookie.com / www.youtube.com): when a visitor plays a video, an iframe loads from YouTube (privacy-enhanced host by default), so the visitor’s IP address and browser user-agent are sent to Google.
  4. Google image CDN (i.ytimg.com / yt3.ggpht.com): thumbnails and channel avatars load from Google servers, which receive the visitor’s IP address and browser headers.
  5. YouTube IFrame Player API (www.youtube.com/iframe_api): loaded in the browser only on video playback when CTA overlays are enabled, to detect pause and end events.

Service provider: Google LLC. YouTube Terms of Service | YouTube API Services Terms | Google Privacy Policy

Privacy

Captain Feed for YouTube helps with GDPR, CCPA and ePrivacy compliance: Privacy-Enhanced Mode (youtube-nocookie.com) is on by default, the plugin sets no tracking cookies, API data is cached locally, and a suggested privacy policy text is added under Settings > Privacy > Policy Guide. Pro adds Consent-Before-Load with CMP detection, Local Thumbnail Caching, and anonymous Feed Analytics (off by default, no IPs or user IDs stored). You remain responsible for your own site’s compliance.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/captain-feed-for-youtube directory, or install the plugin directly from the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins screen.
  3. Go to Captain Feed for YouTube in the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Click Create Feed and select your feed type: Channel, Playlist, Shorts, Search, Single Videos, Channel Profile, or Embed Video.
  5. Enter your YouTube API Key and the required Channel ID, Playlist ID, video details, or search term.
  6. Customize the feed layout, display options, and styling, then click Save.
  7. Copy the generated shortcode and add it to any page, post, or widget area, or add the feed with the Elementor widget or the Gutenberg block.

New to the plugin? Watch the plugin overview video.

To use Pro features, install and activate Captain Feed for YouTube Pro alongside this plugin. The free plugin must stay active.
sections.faq:
How do I add a YouTube feed or gallery to WordPress?

Install Captain Feed for YouTube, add your YouTube API key, click Create Feed, choose a feed type and layout, then paste the generated shortcode [captain-feed-for-youtube id="X"] into any page or post. You can also use the Elementor widget or the Gutenberg block.

Is Captain Feed for YouTube free?

Yes. The core plugin is free and includes channel, playlist, Shorts, search, single video, channel profile and embed feeds, grid and slider layouts, lightbox and inline play, video filters, caching, quota tracking, Elementor and Gutenberg support, and Privacy-Enhanced Mode. Optional Pro features are sold separately in Captain Feed for YouTube Pro.

What does Captain Feed for YouTube Pro add?

Pro adds YouTube Live Streams and Premieres, Call to Action overlays, Feed Analytics, Downtime Alerts, Speed Optimizer with local thumbnail caching, Consent-Before-Load with CMP detection, Infinity Load, device-specific load counts, custom columns and max videos, responsive typography, Short Style 2, thumbnail quality and WebP, custom avatar shape, and White Label.

Do I need a YouTube API key?

For Channel, Playlist, Shorts, Search, Single Videos and Channel Profile feeds, yes. A YouTube Data API v3 key is free and the built-in Documentation walks you through it. The Embed Video feed type does not need an API key.

How do I get a YouTube API Key?

Open the Documentation section inside the plugin for a step-by-step guide, or watch the API key tutorial. A key is created for free in Google Cloud Console.

Does this plugin require Elementor?

No. Elementor is optional. Captain Feed for YouTube works with any modern WordPress theme using the shortcode, and also includes a Gutenberg block.

Can I display YouTube Shorts on my website?

Yes. Use the YouTube Shorts feed type to show short-form videos in a responsive 9:16 layout, as a grid or slider. Short Style 2 (social card design) is available in Pro.

Can I display videos from a playlist?

Yes. Enter the Playlist ID when creating a Playlist feed. The plugin fetches the videos from the public playlist and can show them in a YouTube-style player with a playlist list.

Can I show my entire YouTube channel?

Yes. Enter your Channel ID or @handle when creating a Channel feed.

Can I display videos from multiple channels or playlists?

Yes. Create a separate feed for each channel, playlist, search query or video collection, then place each shortcode anywhere on your site.

Can I display specific YouTube videos only?

Yes. Use the Individual Videos feed type and add the video URLs or IDs you want to feature.

Can I embed one YouTube video without an API key?

Yes. The Embed Video feed type lets you paste a single video URL. It uses YouTube’s public oEmbed endpoint for the title and channel name, so no API key is needed.

Can I show a YouTube live stream on my website?

Live Streams and Premieres are part of Captain Feed for YouTube Pro. They show a pulsing LIVE badge for active broadcasts and a clean offline notice when nothing is live.

Can I play videos in a popup or on the page?

Yes. Each feed can open videos in a popup lightbox, play them inline inside the card, or open them on YouTube.

Can I hide certain videos or only show some?

Yes. Video Filters let you include or exclude videos by keyword and hide videos below a minimum duration or view count.

Does it work with Elementor and the block editor?

Yes. There is an Elementor widget and a Gutenberg block, both named “Captain YouTube Feed”. They show your feed with live styles inside the editor.

Is the plugin GDPR friendly?

Privacy-Enhanced Mode is on by default, so videos load from youtube-nocookie.com and the plugin sets no tracking cookies. For full click-to-load consent gating with automatic Complianz, Cookiebot, CookieYes and Borlabs Cookie detection, use Pro’s Consent-Before-Load. You remain responsible for your own site’s legal compliance.

Is my visitors’ data shared with YouTube or Google?

The plugin itself does not collect or send visitor personal data. When a visitor plays a video or loads a thumbnail from Google servers, their IP address and browser details are sent to Google by their browser. See the External Services section for details. Pro’s Consent-Before-Load and Local Thumbnail Caching reduce this further.

Will the plugin slow down my site?

No. Feeds use cached API responses and load no external Google Fonts. Pro adds lazy loading, preconnect hints and local thumbnail caching for even better Core Web Vitals.

Can I optimize YouTube thumbnails with WebP?

Pro can serve WebP thumbnails with an automatic JPG fallback. For site-wide WebP/AVIF conversion of all images, use our free companion plugin Captain Media Shield.

What happens if I run out of YouTube API quota?

Quota tracking shows your usage, and the optional Fallback Cache keeps the last good videos on screen so your feeds do not go blank. Pro Downtime Alerts can email you or message Slack or Discord when a feed fails.

Does the plugin cache YouTube API responses?

Yes. Responses are cached with WordPress transients, with an optional fallback table, to reduce API usage and improve page speed. You can clear the cache globally or per feed.

How does Downtime Alerts and Incident Monitoring work?

Downtime Alerts (Pro) track feed health in real time. If a request fails because of quota exhaustion, an invalid or restricted key, or a deleted channel, the failure is classified and counted. When your threshold is reached (for example 3 failures in a row), you get an email and optional Slack or Discord alert with a link to fix the feed. Alerts are limited to one per feed per 24 hours, and a recovery notice is sent when the feed works again.

How does Speed Optimizer and Core Web Vitals work?

Speed Optimizer (Pro) includes native lazy loading for thumbnails, preconnect hints for i.ytimg.com and yt3.ggpht.com, conditional loading of player scripts and styles only on pages with a feed, and local thumbnail caching with a live Speed and Cache Report showing hits, misses, hit rate and bandwidth saved.

What are Call to Action overlays?

CTA overlays (Pro) appear when a popup or inline video is paused or finishes. Show a Subscribe prompt, a “watch next” video or a custom button, as a banner or card, with delay and styling controls.

Can AI assistants like Claude manage my feeds?

Yes, optionally. On WordPress 6.9 or newer, with an MCP bridge plugin installed, AI assistants can list, create, update, duplicate, delete and diagnose feeds. Each ability can be switched off from the MCP page.

What is the Rollback feature?

Rollback lets you go back to a previous plugin version from the WordPress admin, without uploading files manually.

Is the plugin beginner-friendly?

Yes. A guided wizard, live preview and built-in documentation mean you can publish a feed in minutes without code.

What happens when I uninstall the plugin?

The plugin has an uninstall routine. If you enable the clean-up option, stored feeds, settings and cached data are removed on uninstall.

1.7.0

  • New: Call to Action (CTA) Overlays (Pro) : Drive conversions when videos pause or finish with custom buttons, channel subscribe prompts, related video switchers, banner or card styles, pause delay controls, and customizable styling.
  • New: Privacy-Enhanced Mode : Video embeds default to youtube-nocookie.com across front-end players, lightbox, Shorts, and previews so no cookies are stored until playback.
  • New: Privacy & GDPR Settings Card : Added dedicated privacy control card in the plugin settings dashboard.
  • New: Consent-Before-Load (Pro) : Click-to-load video placeholder with custom notice, button, styling, and auto-detection for Complianz, Cookiebot, CookieYes, and Borlabs Cookie.
  • New: WordPress Privacy Policy Guide : Registered suggested privacy policy content via wp_add_privacy_policy_content().
  • New: Consent Hooks : Added extensible filters and action hooks for consent-before-load gating and CMP integration.
  • New: Feed Analytics Dashboard (Pro) : Track feed impressions, video plays, watch time, and CTA conversions over time with interactive engagement charts and top-performing videos table.
  • New: Downtime Alerts & Incident Monitoring (Pro) : Real-time feed health tracking, failure threshold controls, email notices, Slack/Discord webhooks, and automatic recovery alerts.
  • New: Speed Optimizer & Core Web Vitals (Pro) : Native thumbnail lazy loading, preconnect hints, conditional asset loading, local thumbnail caching, and speed reports.
  • New: Translatable CTA Frontend Labels : Added full i18n support and localization for CTA overlays via captfyt_cta_i18n.
  • Improved: Custom ColorPicker : Built-in custom ColorPicker integrated across Settings (Placeholder Styling) and Feed Editor (Styles tab) with HEX/RGBA and alpha slider support.
  • Improved: Settings Dialogs : Settings modals (Cache & Performance, Downtime Alerts, Privacy & GDPR, Plugin Data) remain open upon save with instant feedback confirmation.
  • Improved: Feed Health & Diagnostics : Real-time feed health tracking with connection check and quota tracking.
  • Improved: RangeSlider Controls : Range slider with precision number box and clean single reset button without duplicate icons.
  • Fix: Call to Action Layout : Removed redundant Reset All row and perfected control alignment.
  • Fix: Bug fixes, UI refinements, and performance improvements.

1.6.0 (07/11/2026)

  • New: Drag & Drop Settings : Reorder settings cards in Step 4 with layout persistence.
  • New: Slider Controls : Custom slider range design with gradient progress and 1-click reset.
  • New: Live Preview Slider : Real interactive slider navigation with device switching.
  • Improved: White Label : Option to toggle cross-promotion banners across admin screens (Pro).
  • Improved: API Quota Protection : Automatic quota back-off and reset on key update or cache clear.
  • Fix: Security : Hardened Load More endpoint with token signing and rate limiting.
  • Fix: Lightbox : Sanitized video title rendering to prevent DOM XSS.
  • Fix: Settings : Fixed uninstall and preserve settings toggle state display.
  • Fix: Bug fixes, UI refinements, and performance improvements.

1.5.0 (07/10/2026)

  • New: Gutenberg Block : The “Captain YouTube Feed” block is now available in the block editor, letting you select and preview feeds directly with live styles and behavior – just like the Elementor widget.
  • New: Styles Tab for Single Videos : Style controllers have now been added for Single Videos feeds, allowing you to easily customize the background, title, description, image, avatar, and stats.
  • New: Responsive Typography (Pro) : Added a Responsive switcher (Desktop / Tablet / Mobile) to customize font sizes, line heights, and letter spacings per device.
  • New: Custom Columns (Pro) : Columns now feature a “Custom” option to set up to 12 columns per device.
  • New: Max Videos (Pro) : Max Videos now features a “Custom” option to display between 1 to 50 videos.
  • New: Video Tutorials Slider : Added a video tutorials slider on the Help page (under Community & Social Channels) that loads videos only when clicked.
  • New: Documentation Guides : Added comprehensive new guides covering Feed Types, Customization (Layout, Behaviors, Styles), Cache, Reliability, Plugin Data, and White Label (Pro).
  • New: Plugin Overview Video : Added a plugin overview video to the Documentation, Quick Support widget, feed wizard, and the readme’s new YouTube tutorials section.
  • Improved: Single Videos Layout : Removed the unused Columns option and Layout & Display card from Single Videos feeds since they don’t use columns.
  • Improved: Smart Behaviors Tab : The Behaviors tab is now automatically hidden when there are no settings to configure (like Embed Video, Channel Profile, or single-video feeds).
  • Improved: Behaviors Tab Layout : The Behaviors tab now uses a cleaner two-column layout that matches the Layout tab, with unused options automatically hiding to use full width.
  • Improved: White Label Page : The White Label page now displays locked previews of all features showing what Pro unlocks, replacing the simple “Pro feature” message.
  • Improved: Feed Type Selection : You can now change the Feed Type directly from the Embed Video step using the dropdown next to the Feed Name, matching all other feed types.

  • Improved: Slider Arrow Controls : Arrow Vertical Offset and Arrow Horizontal Offset now feature side-by-side sliders with number inputs for easier adjustment.
  • Improved: Frontend Accessibility : Sliders are now announced as carousels, buttons and dots feature translatable labels, auto-slide respects “reduce motion” preferences, keyboard focus is visible, and decorative icons are hidden from screen readers.

  • Fix: Dark Mode API Key Styling : Fixed the YouTube API Key field background and readability of the “API key is valid” message in dark mode.
  • Fix: Minor bug fixes and overall improvements for better stability and performance.

1.4.3 (04/10/2026)

  • New: Equal Card Height : A new “Card Alignment” option on the Behaviors tab (on by default) keeps every card in a row the same height for Style 1, Style 2 and the Social Card style – a video with a two-line title no longer pushes its channel name and stats out of line with its neighbours, and the bottom row now sticks to the bottom edge of each card.

  • Improved: Video Filters card – fixed uneven spacing between its fields, and its expand/collapse arrow now sits on the right like every other card.
  • Improved: The collapsed sidebar menu now keeps the logo and menu icons properly centered.
  • Fix: Load More and Infinity Load did not work on the Playlist layout – the button never appeared, videos loaded afterwards were missing their list number, and Infinity Load never triggered while scrolling the list.
  • Fix: Playlist video titles, channel names and stats were underlined on some themes.
  • Fix: Changing the Feed Type after picking a design (for example Playlist to Shorts) carried the old design through the wizard – Step 2 showed nothing selected and Step 3 previewed the wrong design. Each Feed Type now starts from its own default design.
  • Fix: Minor bug fixes and overall improvements for better stability and performance.

1.4.2 (20/09/2026)

  • New: Live Preview : Added a “Live Preview” option on the Settings step of the feed wizard, opening a full-screen preview of your feed with a Desktop / Tablet / Mobile device switcher.
  • New: Slider Style 3 – Carousel : Added a third Slider style – a counter (“01 / 05”) and prev/next arrows in a toolbar above the cards, with a scroll-progress bar below instead of dots. Available for Grid, Shorts, and Reel feeds.
  • New: Slider Style 2 – Spotlight is now also available for Shorts feeds (previously Grid/Reel only), alongside the existing Style 1 – Equal Cards.
  • New: “Short Style 2” (Pro) : The Shorts social-card design (avatar + handle, likes/comments row) is now a Captain Feed for YouTube Pro feature. Free accounts can still preview it in Select Layout but selecting it opens an upgrade prompt; feeds already using it automatically fall back to Short Style 1 if Pro isn’t active.
  • New: Thumbnail Quality (Pro) : Feeds now use the sharpest thumbnail YouTube provides for each video by default (Full HD when available, instead of capping at 480p). A new Pro “Thumbnail Quality” setting lets you pin a specific tier (Full HD, Standard, or Medium to save page weight).
  • New: Insert Code step redesigned : A “Feed Diagnostic & Cache Status” panel (connection health, configured video count, cache lifetime, last sync) and a “Multi-Platform Embedding Hub” with quick-start cards for the WordPress Block Editor, Elementor, and PHP/theme templates.
  • New: A ready-to-use PHP function snippet – with a “cannot redeclare function” safety check built in – for pasting a feed directly into a child theme’s functions.php, as an alternative to the shortcode.
  • Improved: Renamed the Shorts card designs “Shorts Style” and “Carousel Style” to “Short Style 1” and “Short Style 2” for consistency with the other Slider style names.
  • Improved: The Columns setting (Settings step) is now available for Shorts feeds using a Slider style – it was hidden entirely before, so there was no way to control how many Shorts cards show per view.
  • Fix: A feed using any Slider style could show far fewer videos than its “Max Videos” setting (e.g. only 6 videos even with Max Videos set to 12) – Load More’s “Initial Videos” batch size was silently capping the API fetch even though sliders have no Load More button to fetch the rest.
  • Fix: “Load More” on a Shorts feed using “Short Style 2” rendered additional videos with the wrong card design’s markup, breaking the layout – it now always matches the feed’s actual selected design.
  • Fix: Live Preview modal – removed the “ESC” hint badge from the sidebar button and added spacing below the video grid so it no longer touches the bottom edge.
  • Fix: Minor bug fixes and overall improvements for better stability and performance.

1.4.1 (17/09/2026)

  • New: Infinity Load (Pro) : Added a new “Infinity Load” pagination option that automatically loads the next batch of videos as the visitor scrolls, instead of requiring a manual “Load More” click. Available on Captain Feed for YouTube Pro.
  • Fix: Minor bug fixes and overall improvements for better stability and performance.

1.4.0 (11/09/2026)

  • New: Added a “Social Card” layout style – a card design showing the video engagement stats (views, likes, comments) alongside the thumbnail.
  • Improved: Full RTL (right-to-left) language support – plugin styles now correctly switch to their RTL version on every admin page, not just the Dashboard.
  • Fix: Resolved a YouTube API issue where view counts were displaying incorrectly or randomly instead of fetching accurate stats.
  • Fix: Fixed a display issue where the loading spinner overlapped the “Saving…” text on the Select Layout buttons.
  • Fix: Minor bug fixes and overall improvements for better stability and performance.

For older changelog entries, please see the additional changelog.txt file delivered with the plugin.

short_description: YouTube feed plugin for WordPress: show channel, playlist, Shorts, search and single video galleries with sliders, lightbox and GDPR-friendly embeds.
description:
Captain Feed for YouTube is a fast, beginner-friendly YouTube feed plugin for WordPress. Show your latest YouTube videos, playlists, Shorts, search results and hand-picked videos in a responsive YouTube gallery, grid, slider or playlist player, with no coding. Build a feed in a guided 5-step wizard, copy the shortcode (or use the Elementor widget or Gutenberg block) and your YouTube content is live on your site.

Built for YouTubers, bloggers, businesses, agencies, course creators, churches, podcasters and WordPress developers who want to embed YouTube videos on a WordPress website, grow their channel, and keep visitors watching on their own site.

YouTube Tutorials | Facebook Community | Free Support

Why choose Captain Feed for YouTube?

  • Every YouTube feed type in one plugin : channel feed, playlist feed, Shorts feed, search feed, single videos, channel profile card and no-API-key embed.
  • Fast and quota-friendly : API response caching, an optional fallback cache that keeps your videos on screen even if YouTube or your API quota fails, and built-in API quota tracking.
  • Privacy-first : Privacy-Enhanced Mode (youtube-nocookie.com) is on by default, no tracking cookies, and a suggested privacy policy text for WordPress.
  • Works with your builder : shortcode, Elementor widget, Gutenberg block and a ready-to-paste PHP snippet for theme templates.
  • Looks great everywhere : responsive on desktop, tablet and mobile, with dark mode and RTL support.
  • Upgrade only if you need more : the free plugin is complete for most sites, and Captain Feed for YouTube Pro adds Live Streams, Call to Action overlays, Analytics, Downtime Alerts, Consent-Before-Load, Speed Optimizer, Infinity Load, WebP thumbnails and White Label.

📺 YouTube Feed Types

  • YouTube Channel Feed : show the latest videos from any channel using a Channel ID or @handle.
  • YouTube Playlist Feed : show every video from a public playlist, including a YouTube-style playlist player layout.
  • YouTube Shorts Feed : display vertical Shorts in a responsive 9:16 layout, as a grid, slider or scroll row.
  • YouTube Live Stream Feed (Pro) : show active live broadcasts and scheduled premieres with an animated pulsing LIVE badge and a clean offline notice when nothing is live.
  • YouTube Search Feed : build a dynamic video gallery from any search query, keyword, topic or brand.
  • Individual Videos Feed : hand-pick the exact videos you want to feature, using video URLs or IDs.
  • Embed Video : paste one YouTube URL and embed it instantly. No YouTube API key needed.
  • Channel Profile : show the channel banner, avatar, name, subscriber count, video count, view count and a Subscribe button, in light or dark mode.

🎨 Layouts, Sliders and Card Designs (Free)

  • Card designs : Classic Card, Social Card (views, likes and comments row), Dark Cinematic, Professional, Playlist, Shorts Card, and Short Style 1. Short Style 2 (Pro) adds a social-card Shorts design with avatar, handle and likes and comments row.
  • Grid or Slider : responsive grid with custom columns and gaps, or choose from 3 slider styles (Equal Cards, Spotlight, and Carousel with a counter and progress bar). Auto slide and infinite loop options included.
  • Equal card height : keep every card in a row aligned, even with different title lengths.
  • Show or hide details : channel name, title and description can each be switched off independently on every card style.
  • Pagination and Load More : show a few videos first and load more with a button. Pro adds Infinity Load (auto-load on scroll) and separate Initial Videos and Videos Per Click for tablet and mobile.
  • Columns and Max Videos : choose preset columns and video counts. Pro unlocks custom columns (up to 12 per device) and 1 to 50 videos.
  • Video Order and Max Videos controls to decide what appears and how many.

▶️ Video Play Modes (Free)

  • Popup lightbox : play videos in a clean, accessible popup (GLightbox). Pro adds Call to Action overlays on pause or end.
  • Play inline : play the video right inside the card, one at a time.
  • Open on YouTube : send visitors to YouTube to watch and subscribe.

🖌️ Full Styling with Live Preview (Free)

Style every part of your YouTube gallery visually: card background, borders, radius, shadows, padding, margin, colors, and typography for title, description and stats. A built-in color picker supports HEX and RGBA with alpha. See changes instantly in a Live Preview with a Desktop / Tablet / Mobile switcher. Pro adds Responsive Typography (font size, line height and letter spacing per device), Thumbnail Quality (Full HD, Standard, Medium), WebP thumbnails and a custom Channel Profile avatar shape.

🧹 Video Filters (Free)

Keep your feed clean and on-brand. Include or exclude videos by keyword, hide videos shorter than a minimum duration, or hide videos below a minimum view count. Chip-based suggestions are built from your own channel’s video titles.

🔌 Elementor, Gutenberg and Shortcode (Free)

  • Elementor widget : drag the “Captain YouTube Feed” widget onto any page, pick a feed, and see it styled live in the editor.
  • Gutenberg block : add the “Captain YouTube Feed” block in the WordPress block editor.
  • Shortcode : [captain-feed-for-youtube id="1"] works in any page, post, widget area or page builder.
  • PHP snippet : a ready-to-use function (with a “cannot redeclare” safety check) for theme templates.

⚡ Performance and Reliability (Free)

  • API response caching with WordPress transients to cut requests and speed up page loads.
  • Fallback Cache : keeps the last good videos on screen if the YouTube API fails or your daily quota runs out.
  • API quota tracking with automatic back-off and reset when you update your key or clear the cache.
  • Feed Health and Diagnostics : connection check, cache status and last sync for each feed.
  • Per-feed cache clearing and global cache controls.
  • No external Google Fonts : feeds do not load fonts from Google, which is better for speed and privacy.
  • Pro Speed Optimizer : native thumbnail lazy loading, preconnect hints, conditional asset loading, local thumbnail caching and a live Speed and Cache Report.
  • Pro Downtime Alerts : email, Slack or Discord alerts when a feed fails, with automatic recovery notices.
  • Pro Feed Analytics : impressions, plays, watch time, CTA conversions and top videos, with no personal data stored.
  • Pair it with the free Captain Media Shield to convert thumbnails and site media to WebP/AVIF for even higher PageSpeed scores.

🔒 Privacy and GDPR Tools (Free)

  • Privacy-Enhanced Mode : all players, lightboxes and Shorts load from www.youtube-nocookie.com by default, so YouTube sets no cookies until playback.
  • No tracking cookies and no visitor personal data stored by the plugin.
  • Suggested Privacy Policy text registered under Settings > Privacy > Policy Guide.
  • Upgrade to Pro for click-to-load Consent-Before-Load with automatic Complianz, Cookiebot, CookieYes and Borlabs Cookie detection.

🧰 Admin Experience (Free)

  • Modern React admin dashboard with a guided 5-step feed wizard (Connect Channel, Layout, Mode, Settings, Insert Code).
  • Light and dark admin mode, collapsible sidebar, drag and drop settings cards, mobile-friendly admin.
  • YouTube API key Test Key button with clear error messages (quota exceeded, invalid key, IP restriction, channel not found).
  • Built-in Documentation with guides for the API key, Channel ID, @handle, Playlist ID, Shorts, feed types, customizing a feed, caching, quota tracking, AI assistants and White Label.
  • Quick Support panel with a plugin overview video, free support, feature requests and community links.
  • Version Rollback : go back to any of the last 10 plugin versions from the WordPress admin.
  • Full RTL support and a translation-ready text domain.
  • Clean uninstall option to remove feeds, settings and cached data.

🤖 AI Assistant / MCP Integration (Free)

On WordPress 6.9 or newer, Captain Feed for YouTube registers its feed tools with the core Abilities API, so AI assistants such as Claude, Cursor or ChatGPT can create, list, update, duplicate, delete and diagnose your feeds through any MCP bridge plugin (such as Easy MCP AI or the official WordPress MCP Adapter). It is optional, every ability can be switched on or off from the MCP page, and it is limited to users with the manage_options capability.

🚀 Captain Feed for YouTube Pro

Everything above is free. When you want more conversions, more speed and more control, add Captain Feed for YouTube Pro. The free plugin shows these features locked, so you can see exactly what you get:

  • 🔴 YouTube Live Streams and Premieres : show live broadcasts and scheduled premieres with an animated pulsing LIVE badge and a clean offline state.
  • 🎯 Call to Action (CTA) Overlays : when a video is paused or ends, show a Subscribe prompt, a “watch next” video switcher or a custom button, as a banner or card, with pause delay and full styling.
  • 📊 Feed Analytics : privacy-friendly impressions, card clicks, video plays, watch time, CTA conversions, click-through rate and a top videos table, with interactive charts. No IP addresses, user IDs or cookies stored.
  • 🚨 Downtime Alerts and Incident Monitoring : get email, Slack or Discord alerts when a feed fails (quota exhausted, invalid key, deleted channel), with failure thresholds, no-spam deduplication and automatic recovery notices.
  • ⚡ Speed Optimizer and Core Web Vitals : native thumbnail lazy loading, preconnect hints to Google CDNs, conditional asset loading, local thumbnail caching and a live Speed and Cache Report.
  • 🛡️ Consent-Before-Load (GDPR / CCPA / ePrivacy) : 2-click video placeholder with custom text, button, colors and privacy link, plus automatic CMP detection for Complianz, Cookiebot, CookieYes and Borlabs Cookie.
  • ♾️ Infinity Load : the next videos load automatically as visitors scroll.
  • 📱 Device-specific load counts : separate Initial Videos and Videos Per Click for tablet and mobile.
  • 🔢 Custom Columns and Max Videos : up to 12 columns per device and 1 to 50 videos.
  • 🔤 Responsive Typography : font size, line height and letter spacing for desktop, tablet and mobile.
  • 🩳 Short Style 2 : social-card Shorts design with avatar, handle and likes and comments row.
  • 🖼️ Thumbnail Quality and WebP : pin Full HD, Standard or Medium thumbnails and serve smaller WebP images with automatic JPG fallback.
  • ⭕ Custom Channel Profile avatar shape : any corner radius.
  • 🏷️ White Label for agencies : rename the plugin, set custom menu icons, hide menu items, rebrand the Elementor widget and Gutenberg block, and hide the plugin from the Plugins list.

Get Captain Feed for YouTube Pro

Perfect for

  • YouTube creators who want to showcase new uploads and grow subscribers
  • Businesses displaying product demos, testimonials and explainer videos
  • Bloggers embedding related YouTube videos in posts
  • Agencies building video sections for clients (with White Label in Pro)
  • Course creators, coaches and educators with video lessons and playlists
  • Churches, podcasters and event sites displaying sermons, episodes and live streams
  • Websites that want a YouTube Shorts gallery or a video portfolio

🌟 OUR PRODUCTS

🥇 Captain Media Shield : Automatically optimize photos and videos, convert images to WebP/AVIF across your full WordPress website, and speed up page load times.

🥇 Captain Advance Filter : Create powerful filters for WordPress with advanced filtering options, flexible layouts, and easy customization.

🥇 Captain Social Review : Display reviews and testimonials from multiple platforms with beautiful layouts, filtering options, and easy customization.

🥇 Captain Widgets Kit : Extend your WordPress website with a collection of powerful widgets and elements designed to enhance your website building experience.

🥇 Captain Funnel : Automate WhatsApp messages for WooCommerce orders and form submissions using the official WhatsApp Cloud API by Meta.

🥇 Captain Live Chat : Self-hosted live chat for WordPress with an AI agent, canned replies and full conversation history – no monthly subscription.

External Services

Captain Feed for YouTube connects to Google and YouTube services to retrieve and display videos:

  1. YouTube Data API v3 (www.googleapis.com): the server sends your API key plus the Channel ID or @handle, Playlist ID, video IDs or search query you configured, to fetch videos and channel data. Sent when a feed is first fetched, refreshed after cache expiry, or previewed in admin.
  2. YouTube oEmbed (www.youtube.com/oembed): for the Embed Video type, the server sends the video URL you entered to get the title and channel name. No API key is used.
  3. YouTube players (www.youtube-nocookie.com / www.youtube.com): when a visitor plays a video, an iframe loads from YouTube (privacy-enhanced host by default), so the visitor’s IP address and browser user-agent are sent to Google.
  4. Google image CDN (i.ytimg.com / yt3.ggpht.com): thumbnails and channel avatars load from Google servers, which receive the visitor’s IP address and browser headers.
  5. YouTube IFrame Player API (www.youtube.com/iframe_api): loaded in the browser only on video playback when CTA overlays are enabled, to detect pause and end events.

Service provider: Google LLC. YouTube Terms of Service | YouTube API Services Terms | Google Privacy Policy

Privacy

Captain Feed for YouTube helps with GDPR, CCPA and ePrivacy compliance: Privacy-Enhanced Mode (youtube-nocookie.com) is on by default, the plugin sets no tracking cookies, API data is cached locally, and a suggested privacy policy text is added under Settings > Privacy > Policy Guide. Pro adds Consent-Before-Load with CMP detection, Local Thumbnail Caching, and anonymous Feed Analytics (off by default, no IPs or user IDs stored). You remain responsible for your own site’s compliance.
